title: land reruns the done checks of sprint siblings whose touches share a file with the landing item, so a landing that breaks a sibling's repro stops at its own landing
goal: bl_land.rerun_sibling_checks(bl, ID) returns the failing checks and repros of the sprint's done items whose touches share a file with item ID; land runs it before done and stops naming each that fails

run:
import json,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P,subprocess as s
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_land
r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());s.run(["git","init","-q",str(r)],check=True)
d=r/"kb"/"_self"/"backlog";d.mkdir(parents=True)
def w(i,**k):(d/(i+".json")).write_text(json.dumps({"id":i,"priority":"P3","title":"t",**k},indent=2)+"\n")
w("SP-aaaaaaaa",kind="sprint",status="active",goal="g")
F=[{"run":["python3","-c","import sys;sys.exit(1)"]}]
w("ST-aaaaaaaa",kind="story",status="done",sprint="SP-aaaaaaaa",goal="g",touches=["x.txt"],checks=F)
w("ST-bbbbbbbb",kind="story",status="done",sprint="SP-aaaaaaaa",goal="g",touches=["y.txt"],checks=F)
w("ST-cccccccc",kind="story",status="doing",sprint="SP-aaaaaaaa",goal="g",touches=["x.txt"],checks=[{"run":["python3","-c","print(1)"]}])
bl=bl_land.Backlog(r);print(sorted(bl.sprint_items("SP-aaaaaaaa")))
f=getattr(bl_land,"rerun_sibling_checks",None)
if f is None:print("bl_land has no rerun_sibling_checks");sys.exit(1)
ids=sorted({x[0] for x in f(bl,"ST-cccccccc")});print("failing siblings:",ids);sys.exit(0 if ids==["ST-aaaaaaaa"] else 1)
import re,sys;s=open("_tools/bl_land.py",encoding="utf-8").read();n=len(re.findall(r"(?<!def )rerun_sibling_checks\(",s));print("calls of rerun_sibling_checks in bl_land:",n);sys.exit(0 if n else 1)

clauses.clause: bl_land.rerun_sibling_checks(bl, ID) returns the failing checks and repros of the sprint's done items whose touches share a file with item ID
land runs it before done and stops naming each that fails

gates.question: Which touches overlap makes a done item a sibling whose checks land reruns, and where does the step sit in the landing? Rationale for the first: a shared doc is merged by the rebase and gated by stale, so counting it would turn most landings into whole-sprint reruns.
options: touches_meet; before done (content) and after checks (code lane)
gates.recommendation: touches_meet; before done (content) and after checks (code lane)

A landing reruns the checks and repros of the sprint's done items whose touches share a file with its own and stops on one that fails. Check 1 reads bl_land for a call of it (paired with check 0, which runs it).
